title: Jinni Engineering Field Manual
description:
A practical approach to contracting agents.

Every artifact that instructs an executor running beyond your supervision is a contract with a jinni: a prompt or brief handed to a subagent, a skill or standing procedure that instructs many future executions, a spec handed to a contractor, a tool description, a policy. One failure geometry runs under all of them, and one authoring discipline answers it: the contractor model, why over-precision fails, why vagueness is not the alternative, where precision goes (ends, floors, acceptance; means left free; the because carried always), the anatomy of a well-drawn contract, what lives outside the text, the handover procedure, contract classes (subagent, skill, human, guard), an abuse bestiary, a pre-issue checklist, and the contract the manual itself signs with its reader.

Permanent address: https://w3id.org/jinni
